column1: # One line per model column (subtool). family = adapter in bench/adapters/<family>.py; arg = what that adapter needs
# (Dorado: the modification model in $DORADO_MODELS; UniMeth: 'checkpoint;flags;frequency', ${KEY} = setting KEY;
# MethyNano: the species checkpoint folder; RawMod: see config/rawmod_models.tsv).
# UniMeth: the released 5 kHz models, run at --frequency 5khz.
# unimeth_ft_* (UniMeth-FT in the paper): UniMeth fine-tuned from the released 5 kHz models with labels only at the
# positions the released RawMod model trained on (evaluation/train_unimeth_ft.sh), run with the patched source
# codes = which per-read modification codes count as "modified" for this column (comma-separated; * = any).
# bases = + strand bases the subtool has a model for; context = cpg (CpG-only model) or any. A subtool is N/A on a
# row whose modified base it does not model, or (context cpg) on a non-CpG row; it is never scored there.
# unimeth_reg_* (UniMeth-FT in the region-holdout benchmark): as unimeth_ft_*, but fine-tuned without any read that
# overlaps a held-out test region (evaluation/train_unimeth_ft_region.sh), so it is scored on reads and regions it never saw.
# unimeth_agn (UniMeth-Agn): one modification-agnostic UniMeth model fine-tuned on every training image of the released
# RawMod model (evaluation/train_unimeth_agn.sh), asked at every C, A and T; patched source, --frequency 4khz, as trained.
# unimeth_agn_mod: as unimeth_agn, but one general [MOD] question token at every C, A and T (UNIMETH_MODTOK_PYTHONPATH).
# unimeth_agn_reg / unimeth_agn_mod_reg: the region-holdout UniMeth-Agn (no read overlapping a held-out region in training).
# uncalled4 (comparative, Kovaka et al. 2025): one-sample KS of the K selected reads vs. a control pore model -- trained on
# the row's unmodified control library, or the released WGA-trained model on one-sample rows (bench.uncalled4_sites).
# novamod (unsupervised VAE of unmodified signal, Zou et al. 2026): per-read reconstruction score; novamod = one model per
# unmodified control library (blank on one-sample rows), novamod_pooled = one model on all four control libraries
# unimeth_agn_lo_<NAME>: region UniMeth-Agn [MOD] trained without the libraries of NAME (train_unimeth_agn.sh
# UNIMETH_AGN_LEAVEOUT); family unimeth_agn_mod so that no Table 1 column (family unimeth_agn_mod_reg) takes the max over them.
